hero.eyebrow: Delivery in Lomé, 7 days a week
hero.title: Your parcels, meals and groceries delivered fast in Lomé

services.title: What we deliver
services.subtitle: One service for everything you need delivered across Lomé.

parcel.title: Parcels and documents
parcel.text: Packages, envelopes, important papers: picked up and handed over in person.

meal.title: Meals
meal.text: Your favourite dishes picked up at the restaurant and delivered still hot.

groceries.title: Groceries
groceries.text: Market or supermarket: we pick up your shopping and bring it to you.

steps.title: How it works
steps.subtitle: Three simple steps, from your phone.

step1.title: Tell us the route
step1.text: Give us the pick-up point, the drop-off point and the size of your item.

step2.title: Get your price
step2.text: The price is based on the road distance. No surprises.

step3.title: We handle the rest
step3.text: A courier picks up and delivers your item. You pay cash on delivery.

fast.title: Fast
fast.text: Usually delivered in 30 to 60 minutes, depending on distance.

price.title: Transparent pricing
price.text: Based on distance, starting from 500 FCFA.

cash.title: Cash on delivery
cash.text: You pay in cash once the delivery is done.

available.title: Available 7 days a week
available.text: Order any time, for immediate or scheduled delivery.

cta.title: Something to deliver?
cta.text: Message us on WhatsApp, we reply quickly.
